subject: Science
description: The DNA double helix: two twisted backbones joined by base-pair rungs
alt: A vertical DNA double helix: two twisting sugar-phosphate backbones joined by rungs of paired bases
prompt: A vertical DNA double helix, about two and a half turns. Two intertwining backbone ribbons (one blue, one teal) crossing regularly, joined by short horizontal rungs (base pairs); each rung is two halves meeting in the middle, with one rung pair in the orange accent. Evenly spaced, perfectly regular twist.
checklist: exactly two backbone strands twisting around the same axis with a regular pitch
rungs are evenly spaced and all about the same length, each connecting the two strands
the strands cross at regular intervals with consistent over-under order
